messages:
emma_devex: Heads-up from yesterday's onboarding: customers got inconsistent env var names across samples and SDKs. They tried RW_KEY, RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY, and ended up pasting the wrong key into a frontend bundle.

frank_sdk: Oof. Quick inventory: Go/Java SDKs look for `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Python accepts `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `RW_API_KEY`. Node tries `RW_API_KEY` first. That's clearly the problem.

gita_se: Also saw confusion around which key to use: org vs project. Our policy docs are scattered. New devs assume org keys are "global admin" and use them everywhere. We should make CLI and docs steer them to project-scoped keys for services by default.

harry_cli: Agree. Small CLI UX fixes I can do this week: when you run `redwood keys list` show a "scope" column (org/project) and add a `--default-for` output that recommends the type for the current project. Also default key create to `--scope=project` unless `--scope=org` is explicit.

emma_devex: Can we land a single canonical env var and make SDKs accept it with a deprecation path for older names? That'll let quickstarts be consistent.

frank_sdk: Proposal: canonical vars = `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `REDWOOD_ORG`, `REDWOOD_PROJECT`. SDKs should: 1) read `REDWOOD_API_KEY` primarily; 2) fallback to `RW_API_KEY` for 3 months with a logged deprecation warning (masked logs). Provide a `Client.fromEnv({ strict: true })` that errors if `RW_API_KEY` is present but `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is missing.

gita_se: Security + rotation: we need a standard rotate flow. Recommend server apps use short-lived tokens (15m) fetched via a rotation endpoint using a long-lived `rotation_token` stored in a KMS. SDKs will implement `client.rotateIfNeeded()` which will call `POST /v1/auth/rotate` with the rotation token, validate new creds, and swap them atomically. No app restart.

emma_devex: Can we include a tiny sample in the README for rotation? People love copy-paste.

frank_sdk: Definitely. Example (python):
```
# simple rotation helper
client = RedwoodClient.fromEnv()
if client.needs_rotation():
    client.rotate()
```
Node example similar with `client.rotateIfNeeded()` and promises.

gita_se: Logging: SDKs should never print full secrets. Masking rule: any string matching `^sk_live_|^sk_test_|^[A-Za-z0-9-_]{30,}$` should be replaced with `<redacted-key>` in logs. Add unit tests that assert logs don't contain raw keys.

emma_devex: What about retries for non-idempotent calls? Folks complained when an embedding request retried double-inserting metadata.

frank_sdk: New default: only auto-retry idempotent endpoints (status code 409 tolerance on idempotent ops). For non-idempotent endpoints, require an `idempotency_key` param to enable retries. CODE SNIPPET: `client.responses.create({ prompt }, { idempotencyKey: 'abc' })`. We'll add this to the SDK spec.

harry_cli: For key rotation through CLI: add `redwood keys rotate KEY_ID --write-env .env.service --atomic` which will rotate server-side, fetch the new secret, run a health check (test `GET /v1/health`), then write the env file if successful. Default behavior should print `Key rotated and written to .env.service (secret masked)`. To actually display the secret require `--show-secret` and interactive 2FA.

emma_devex: Nice. Also update templates: change quickstarts in `templates/python` and `templates/node` to use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and include a `rotation` section with the CLI one-liner.

gita_se: One more security ask: audits. Make `redwood keys create` emit an audit event with scope and created_by but never the secret in audit logs. Also add `redwood keys expire KEY_ID --in 7d` helper.

frank_sdk: I'll draft an SDK RFC today to cover env vars, deprecation timeline, idempotency, rotate helper, and masked logging. Will include code samples for Python, Node, Go.

harry_cli: I'll pick up the CLI changes after the RFC lands. Target PRs: CLI scope display + rotate write flow within 5 business days.

emma_devex: Great. After RFC+PR, we'll update docs and roll out a short support note to customers who used RW_API_KEY in the past 6 months.

ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket DEVEX-4321 for SDK env var RFC. link: https://pm.internal/redwood/DEVEX-4321

emma_devex: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-ups and marking action items.
